reference.title: Quota management and proxy cache features
reference.shortdesc: The following configuration fields enforce storage quotas and enable proxy caching of upstream registry images in Red Hat Quay.

section.p: These features help registry administrators with the following:

ul.li: Controlling how much storage organizations and users consume with configurable quotas.
Improving access to upstream images by caching remote content locally via proxy cache.
Monitoring and managing resource consumption and availability across distributed environments.

section.p: Collectively, these capabilities ensure better performance, governance, and resiliency in managing container image workflows.
